thread:
anya (eng-security): Quick check — I pushed a change to staging ingress that temporarily logs uploaded filenames at request.body.upload.filename for debugging. Filenames may include emails. Should we redact filenames entirely or HMAC them? Need to decide before I turn on 48h retention.

ben (eng-sre): If filenames can contain emails, treat as PII. Prefer pseudonymize (HMAC) so we can still dedupe if needed. Also lock access.

chris (devex): @anya can you paste a sanitized example log line so we can craft the scrub rule?

anya (eng-security): ```json
{"request_id":"req_123","user_id":"u_444","body":{"upload":{"filename":"jane.doe@example.com_resume.pdf","size":234234}}}
```

maria (privacy): That includes an email -> PII. Two safe options: (1) redact filename entirely, or (2) replace with HMAC(filename) using an app-level salt stored in KMS. HMAC preferred if downstream dedupe/analytics rely on a stable token.

ben (eng-sre): HMAC works. Make sure the original never flows to error tracking or metrics. Check Sentry and trace/span annotations.

anya (eng-security): Plan: ingress will compute `hmac_sha256(filename)` and write `upload.filename_hmac` only, then remove `upload.filename`. Also add a transform to strip raw filename before spans are created. Do I need any approval to use KMS-managed salt for this?

maria (privacy): No special exec approval for KMS usage, but create an audit entry and document who can access the mapping. Also note salt rotation requirements in the PR.

audit-bot: audit-bot: access request created by anya: req-5678 — https://internal/audit/req-5678 :lock:

chris (devex): :thumbsup: Nice. @ben can you review the PR to confirm Sentry/traces/metrics won't capture the raw filename?

ben (eng-sre): Will do. I'll comb Sentry config, tracing annotations, and any metric labels. ETA today EOD.

anya (eng-security): Thanks — I'll open the PR now and ping this thread when it's ready.
